$comment: The brand's consumer line as the owner's concept boards of 2026-11-05 define it. Seeded into module 18 as dossiers at the idea stage and shown by sample mode; never typed into a screen. Only what the boards say is here: composition, sizes, prices, suppliers and launch dates stay empty until the owner gives them. The two hex values are read from the colour chips on the phone-case board.

collections.name: The T-Shirt Collection
collections.theme: Better basics for a brighter tomorrow. Four tees: Essential, Baby, Sculpt and Relaxed. The Everyday Edit pairs the Essential and the Relaxed.

collections.name: Sleepwear / Babydoll Collection
collections.theme: Everyday essentials for a more beautiful you. Soft, feminine, modern, essential. Pajama sets: effortless comfort. Babydolls: romantic and modern. Robes and lounge: layered luxury. Seventeen styles in a palette of Ivory, Stone, Blush, Mauve, Sage and Black.

collections.name: Drop 01
collections.theme: The iPhone 18 Case Collection. Same essence. Different device. Less complexity. More margin. Inspired by the materials behind fashion.

products.intent: Better basics for a brighter tomorrow.

products.name: Model 1
products.description: A soft-structured shoulder bag in draped mesh: one curved handle on ring hardware, a sculpted base and a discreet BASIS mark. 32 × 20 × 12 cm. Five colours, and the same silhouette told in five materials: illusion mesh, satin drape, suede touch, pebbled leather and gloss finish.
products.intent: Everyday luxury. Soft structure, signature draped mesh, iconic silhouette, lightweight, everyday elegance.

products.name: iPhone 18 Case
products.description: A slim case for iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max with a matte micro-woven textile finish inspired by BASIS textiles. TPU and PC construction, about 1.6 to 2.0 mm, full camera-plate coverage, tactile buttons and a hidden MagSafe magnet ring. Two colours: Warm Bone and Soft Black.
products.intent: Same essence. Different device. Less complexity. More margin. Inspired by the materials behind fashion. A high-margin product, ideal for the drop model.

materials.name: TPU + PC construction
materials.specification: Durable and flexible. Lightweight, about 1.6 to 2.0 mm. Slim profile, seamless construction.

materials.name: Matte micro-woven textile finish
materials.specification: Inspired by BASIS textiles. Clean, durable, easy to produce.

materials.name: Camera plate protection
materials.specification: Full coverage for the iPhone 18 Pro series. Precision fit around the wide camera plateau. Matte, scratch-resistant finish.

materials.name: Hidden MagSafe magnet ring
materials.specification: No visible graphics. Clean interior construction.

materials.name: Tactile buttons
materials.specification: Accurate cutouts, full access to all ports.
